description:
What is This Part?
These are the Suzuki OEM Sway Bar Connecting Plates & Bushings.
If you still have the Original Bushings on your Samurai then you definitely need these!
Better Handling / Smoother Ride
Includes the Attachment Bolts!
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – Cushions (Sway Bar)
Qty 2 – Plates
Qty 4 – Bolts
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
